required_capabilities: Load Library Element Type (×2); Create Door (×2); Replace Element Type (×1); Inspect Project (×1)
instruction: The room is a simple rectangle with four exterior walls already built. Do not modify any walls. Place a Rectangular Door Opening on the top (north) wall, 900 × 2100 mm, with its left edge 3000 mm from the top-left corner, measured along the wall. Place a Double Door with 2 Sidelights on the right (east) wall, 2300 × 2100 mm, opening outward, with its edge closest to the top-right corner 2500 mm from that corner, measured down along the wall. Create no additional doors or openings.

double door with 2 sidelights on the east wall
